title: Loop Plasticity Drives Paralog-Specific Recognition in BET ET Domains.
authors: Alvarez, Guadalupe; Sebastian, Elizabeth; Mondal, Arup; Roth, Monica J; Montelione, Gaetano T; Perez, Alberto
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD模拟研究BET家族ET结构域识别肽段的旁系同源特异性，虽为蛋白-肽互作而非TF-DNA体系，但动态环路调控结合腔的机制和MD方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作建模。
abstract: The bromodomain and extraterminal domain (BET) family uses its conserved ET domains to recognize diverse peptide motifs, yet exhibits paralog-specific binding preferences whose structural origins remain poorly understood. Using extensive molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of BRD3-ET and BRD4-ET and experimental data for the unbound and peptide-bound states, we show that paralog selectivity arises not from large structural rearrangements but from subtle differences in the dynamics of the alpha2-alpha3 loop. Two divergent residues at positions 35 and 36 in this loop modulate the formation of flanking helices (eta1 and eta2), which in turn control the opening of the peptide-binding cavity and determine how each paralog accommodates distinct binding modes. These sequence-encoded dynamical differences shape the number, stability, and geometry of accessible binding modes and provide a structural rationale for paralog-specific targeting of BET proteins.
abstract_zh: 溴结构域和末端外结构域（BET）家族利用其保守的ET结构域识别多种肽基序，却表现出旁系同源物特异的结合偏好，其结构起源仍知之甚少。通过对BRD3-ET和BRD4-ET进行广泛的分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，并结合未结合和肽结合状态的实验数据，我们表明旁系同源物选择性并非源于大的结构重排，而是来自alpha2-alpha3环动力学的细微差异。该环中第35和36位的两个分歧残基调节侧翼螺旋（eta1和eta2）的形成，进而控制肽结合腔的开放，并决定每个旁系同源物如何适应不同的结合模式。这些由序列编码的动力学差异塑造了可及结合模式的数量、稳定性和几何结构，并为BET蛋白的旁系同源物特异性靶向提供了结构依据。
